manifest.purpose: Golden answer mirroring submission/recovered_rtl.v. Defines exactly one module reg_file_recovered with pinned ports: input clk, rst, we, [1:0] waddr, [7:0] wdata, [1:0] raddr0, [1:0] raddr1; output [7:0] rdata0, rdata1. Internal storage: reg [7:0] mem[0:3] (4 entries), updated in a single always @(posedge clk) block: if (rst) clear all 4 entries to 8'h00 synchronously (rst has priority over we, we ignored while rst=1); else if (we) mem[waddr] <= wdata (exactly one entry updates, others hold). Read ports are purely combinational: assign rdata0 = mem[raddr0]; assign rdata1 = mem[raddr1]; -- zero-latency Mealy reads, no bypass mux, no extra pipeline register, satisfying write-forwarding naturally (post-edge registered value visible immediately via delta-cycle combinational read), reset visibility on next edge, and independent dual-port reads. No latches, no combinational feedback, no non-synthesizable constructs, self-contained single module.
